text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kool~! Daitaku Helios in the house, yo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My dream is a lifelong festival!
Like, riding a massive wave and partying hard, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First off, we're going totally serious with the vibes! Put me through the wringer, capisce~♪

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
